name: Museum of Contemporary Art and Design (MCAD)
known: Its projects include Curatorial Conversations (a mentoring programme for young curators), MCAD Commons (a collaborative exhibition platform) and MCAD Publications (Daily Tribune, 4 November 2025).

name: Metropolitan Museum of Manila
known: Joselito Campos Jr. chairs the museum's Board of Trustees (Lifestyle Asia, 22 November 2021).
Wikipedia says he founded NutriAsia in 1990, chairs it and is vice chairman of Del Monte Philippines.

name: KALEKTAR research platform on Belarusian contemporary art
known: Shabohin has been co-founder and editor-in-chief since 2015 (Contexts).
The history page says the project shifted from a proposed private museum to an open online archive, and that the artists developed the concept with the curator Alyaksei Barysyonka.
Co-founder and editor-in-chief Sergey Shabohin lives in Białystok, the map point, as the platform publishes no address.

name: Museum of the Second World War
Bunkier Sztuki Gallery of Contemporary Art
known: Directors: Krzysztof Głuchowski (1995 to 1999), Jarosław Suchan (1999 to 2002), Maria Anna Potocka (2002 to 2010 and 2019 to 2024), Piotr Cypryański (2010 to 2014), Magdalena Ziółkowska (2014 to 2018) and Delfina Jałowik (since 2024) (Polish Wikipedia).

name: Cricoteka (Centre for the Documentation of the Art of Tadeusz Kantor)
known: Museum, archive, gallery and research centre devoted to the director and painter Tadeusz Kantor (1915 to 1990), in the Podgórze district of Kraków at ul.
Founded in Kraków in 1980 on Kantor's initiative as a "living archive" of his Cricot 2 theatre, which Kantor co-founded in 1955 with Maria Jarema and Kazimierz Mikulski (stated by the space).

name: MOCAK
known: Maria Anna (Masza) Potocka was its first director (Wikipedia).
On site: permanent and temporary exhibitions, a library, a bookshop, a café and a contemporary art conservation laboratory (Wikipedia).
Her successor Adam Budak was dismissed in May 2026 and Grzegorz Kuźma has been acting director since 12 May 2026 (ArtReview).
On 19 October 2026 the museum's site announced that, by order of the President of the City of Kraków, the competition for a new director was cancelled.

name: Muzeum Sopotu
known: The museum's Museum Council includes academics from the University of Gdańsk and Nicolaus Copernicus University, a monument conservator, a deputy director of the Museum of Gdańsk and a representative of the Sopot Auction House (museum site).

name: Zofia and Oskar Hansen House
known: Numbers are very limited for conservation reasons.
The EFC Foundation was set up in 2008 by Andrzej Czernecki (1939 to 2012), founder of HTL-Strefa, which the foundation says held 85 percent of the world market for blood glucose testing devices.

name: Belarusian Council for Culture (Rada Kultury)
known: Staff named on its site: Siarhiej Budkin, CEO.
Nadzieja Haretskaja, deputy director.
Elina Kałnibałockaja, development director.

name: Galeria Foksal (Foksal Gallery)
known: Borowski was nominally its director for nearly 35 years (stated by the gallery).
Interior designed by the artists Zbigniew Gostomski, Edward Krasiński and Zygmunt Targowski, including the cabinets, bookshelves and chairs, which remain unchanged (stated by the gallery).
Current curators named on the contact page: Zuzanna Mielczarek (programme curator), Katarzyna Krysiak and Martyna Stołpiec.

name: Kupalaŭcy (Free Kupala Theatre in exile)
known: Wikipedia says director-general Pavel Latushko was fired on 17 August 2020 and 58 actors and staff were dismissed on 26 August 2020.

Pavel Latushka, deputy head of the United Transitional Cabinet and former director of the Kupala Theatre, sent the request to the minister Hanna Wróblewska in October 2024 and she approved it on 17 March 2025 (Reform.news, 18 March 2025).

name: Museum of Free Belarus
known: Parent: the National Anti-Crisis Management, headed by Pavel Latushka, who is also Deputy Head of the United Transitional Cabinet of Belarus (his own post on the National Anti-Crisis Management site, 25 May 2024).
